title: Checkout connection acquisition triage
body: Owner: checkout on-call. For checkout-api acquire-timeout reports, compare release configuration with the last healthy deployment. Distinguish waiting for a local payment-client connection from provider-adapter upstream response time. Ask for active connections, configured ceiling, pending acquisitions, and request concurrency through dedicated telemetry tools. Compare checkout and payment-api observations before assigning cause. If the change window aligns, propose a reviewed configuration rollback; do not increase limits blindly or restart all replicas.
